_comment: Physical exams and immigration medical forms. Each has its own page under /physicals/. civilSurgeonName: the USCIS-designated civil surgeon as listed in the USCIS civil surgeon locator.

list.name: Immigration physical (Form I-693)
list.summary: The USCIS medical exam and vaccination record for green card applicants, completed by a USCIS-designated civil surgeon.

list.name: Disability exception for citizenship (Form N-648)
list.summary: A physician review of your medical records to see if you qualify for an exception to the English and civics tests for U.S. citizenship.

list.name: Driver's license physical (PennDOT DL-180)
list.summary: The physical exam you need for a Pennsylvania non-commercial learner's permit. We complete the medical part of your DL-180.

list.name: School physical
list.summary: The physical Pennsylvania requires at school entry, 6th grade and 11th grade, on the Department of Health form.
